title: Alphabet agrees to buy Intersect for $4.75B cash plus debt

sources.quote: Kirkland & Ellis advised a group of investors in Intersect on a definitive agreement to sell Intersect, which provides data center and energy infrastructure solutions, for $4.75 billion in cash, plus the assumption of debt, to Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG).

explain: Alphabet agreed to buy Intersect, a developer that builds power plants together with data centers, for $4.75 billion in cash plus assumed debt; the cash goes to sellers TPG Rise Climate, Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital. Google already owned a minority stake. Intersect's operating Texas and California assets are excluded from the deal.
